svg.title: Adaptive RAG. A question first goes to a judge that rates how complex it is. A simple question, like the capital of France, is answered by the model alone. A medium one, like the price of the Signature Steak, gets one search, then an answer. A complex one, like which wine suits the lobster bisque for someone who dislikes oak, gets several rounds of searching and reasoning.
